entries.name: Lateral step-in to rotational plant
entries.sourceDose: 1 × 2 per receiving leg = 4 efforts. From a parallel athletic stance, make one brisk, short lateral step onto the receiving foot, then redirect the pelvis through a comfortable turn of up to 45° into a split kick stance. Let the receiving heel release and the other foot realign; finish still for 2 s. No kick, run-up or flight. Keep step/finish within 2 m, with another 2 m clear for recovery. Rest 25 s between efforts, then 90 s before E6.
